train_candidate_sampling: uniform with replacement within original image; independent SHA256-derived numpy generators for seed/image_id/epoch/stride/axis; candidates filtered by both original GT values and mapped crop pixel centers
empty_scale: mean only nonempty scales; all empty returns graph-connected zero and is logged
best_epoch_rule: among epochs with RMSE and full-pair 14px MAE <= 1.05 times E0, minimize sampled 14px MAE for abs GT difference >=0.2m; if within 0.000001m of minimum choose lower absolute RMSE, then earlier epoch; if no eligible epoch, none
